title: unified-rollouts: canary & shadow autorollback - observability and safety guards
author: Maya Singh
commits: Add telemetry events and tags for canary and shadow traffic
Expose per-rollout metric breakdowns and histograms
Safety guards: min-sample thresholds, quarantine stage, cooldown enforcement
Add e2e tests for autorollback observability and metric-driven alerts
description:
Background and motivation: production rollouts using unified-rollouts (canary / AB / shadow) recently experienced a couple of noisy autorollbacks triggered by insufficient sample counts and ambiguous metric attribution between shadow and live traffic. This PR adds improved observability and safety guards to reduce false positives, make rollbacks auditable, and give SREs the signals needed to tune thresholds.

What this PR does (single continuous description): Adds new telemetry events (rollout.start, rollout.step, rollout.quarantine, rollback.initiated, rollback.decision_reasons) with rollout_id and traffic_tag dimensions; tags all canary and shadow requests with rollout metadata so traces and logs can be correlated; exposes per-rollout metric breakdowns (latency p50/p95, error-rate, token-drop-rate) and histograms in the metrics API; introduces a min_sample_count safety guard for metric-driven autorollbacks and a quarantine stage that places suspicious variants into a probing-only state instead of a full rollback when quorum is not reached; enforces a cooldown window after an autorollback to avoid thrashing; surfaces rollback decision rationale in the rollout timeline for easier postmortem and runbook use.

Files changed (high level): runtime/rollout/controller.go - add telemetry hooks, safety checks, and cooldown logic; runtime/rollout/metrics.go - per-rollout metric aggregation and histograms; api/rollouts/handlers.go - expose new endpoints for rollout timelines and breakdowns; observability/dashboards/unified-rollouts.json - Grafana dashboard with new panels; tests/e2e/rollout_observability_test.go - new e2e test harness to simulate regressions; docs/rollouts/safety-guards.md - operator-facing docs and runbook.

Checklist: [x] Add telemetry events and metadata tagging; [x] Implement min_sample_count and quarantine flow; [x] Add cooldown enforcement; [x] Provide dashboards and dashboard JSON; [x] Unit + integration tests; [x] e2e test simulating regression and verifying quarantine vs rollback; [x] Docs and runbook updates; [x] Feature gated behind rollout.observability.feature_flag (off by default).

Testing and validation: Local unit tests added for metrics aggregation and decision logic. Integration tests validate that shadow traffic is correctly tagged and that metric attribution splits shadow vs live. e2e tests run against the perf-canary harness to simulate a quality regression: when sample volume < min_sample_count the variant is placed into quarantine and a human-facing note is created instead of immediate rollback; when sample volume meets quorum and metric thresholds are exceeded the autorollback triggers as expected. CI initially showed a flaky test (metrics aggregation edge-case) which was fixed by adding a deterministic clock in tests.

Rollout plan: Feature-flagged behind rollout.observability.feature_flag = false by default. Plan: enable in staging (canary account) for 48 hours, monitor new dashboard for false-positive autorollbacks, enable for 10% of deployments in prod, then ramp to 100% after 2 weeks if no regressions. Ops can manually set quarantine -> rollback or restore via the rollout UI.

Notes/limitations: This PR does not change the default metric thresholds (teams should tune min_sample_count and SLO thresholds per workload). The quarantine state is intentionally conservative to reduce churn; follow-up work will add automated remediation suggestions for common failure modes.

Related: ENG-4523 (primary), SUP-1123 (customer incident that motivated faster signal), internal RFC: rfc/unified-rollouts-observability.md (links in PR description).
